banner.title: downloads pvc
banner.tagline: Two claims for the download pipeline: RWX shared-downloads for the *arr apps, and RWO SABnzbd scratch that nothing backs up.

explainer.title: Scratch for assembly, shared space for imports

steps.title: Assemble
steps.text: sabnzbd-incomplete is a 1500Gi ceph-block claim. SABnzbd writes article files there, which keeps the small-file churn off CephFS.
steps.scene: tiny article blocks piling into a block-storage stack

steps.title: Share
steps.text: shared-downloads is a 2Ti ceph-filesystem-rwx claim, mounted read-write by SABnzbd and the *arr apps at /data/downloads.
steps.scene: several app nodes sharing one folder tree

steps.title: Unbacked
steps.text: Neither claim is in a backup engine, by design. The scratch is disposable, and an empty shared tree after a rebuild is expected, not a restore failure.
steps.scene: an open volume with no archive box beside it

art.about: two storage claims for a download pipeline, one scratch and one shared
art.title: How the download volumes are laid out
